# Chance to Avoid Damage (incl. Blur)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** defense, avoidance, blur

## Setup

Equip a source of Chance to Avoid Damage (gear affix) and/or activate Blur (Putrid Toad elixir → the Blur Active condition), optionally with Blur Effect. Read the Damage Avoidance panel on the Player Stats screen.

## Raw data points

Sourced from the TLI Help Database, not yet confirmed live. Chance to Avoid Damage: 0% base, hard-capped at 60%, rolled independently per damage type (a multi-type hit may avoid one type, both, or neither). Blur: each Blur Rating grants 0.25% Chance to Avoid Damage, scaled by Blur Effect; Max Blur Rating is 100, so full Blur = 25% at +0% effect, or 50% at +100% Blur Effect (before the 60% total cap).

## Derived / confirmed formula

dmg_avoid_chance = min(Σ gear/affix sources + blur, 0.60); blur = 100 · 0.0025 · (1 + blur_effect_inc) while Blur Active (modeled at max rating — the full-uptime planner assumption; real-uptime rating decay of 10%/s is not yet modeled).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Open verification items: (1) confirm the 0.25%/rating and 60% cap live; (2) confirm per-type independent roll; (3) real-uptime Blur rating decay (currently modeled at max rating); (4) how avoidance composes with Evasion in the incoming-damage / EHP model (WS3, separate layers — evasion cap 75%, avoidance cap 60%).

## Implementation (engine model)

engine/defense.py::_blur_avoid_chance + calculate_defense (dmg_avoid_chance capped at _MAX_DMG_AVOID_CHANCE = 0.60; dmg_avoid_blur broken out for UI attribution; blur_effect_inc now consumed). UI: PlayerStatsScreen.tsx Damage Avoidance panel shows Blur as an attributed breakdown row + the 60% cap.
